vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2022-42003
vulnerabilities.description: In FasterXML jackson-databind before 2.14.0-rc1, resource exhaustion can occur because of a lack of a check in primitive value deserializers to avoid deep wrapper array nesting, when the UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS feature is enabled.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2020-36518
vulnerabilities.description: jackson-databind before 2.13.0 allows a Java StackOverflow exception and denial of service via a large depth of nested objects.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2021-44228
vulnerabilities.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints (Log4Shell). Remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2022-42889
vulnerabilities.description: Apache Commons Text performs variable interpolation, allowing properties to be dynamically evaluated and expanded (Text4Shell). Arbitrary code execution when processing untrusted input.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2022-1471
vulnerabilities.description: SnakeYaml's Constructor() class does not restrict types which can be instantiated during deserialization, leading to remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2023-2976
vulnerabilities.description: Use of Java's default temporary directory for file creation in FileBackedOutputStream allows other users to access or modify the content.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2020-8908
vulnerabilities.description: A temp directory creation vulnerability exists in Guava versions prior to 32.0.0.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2024-22243
vulnerabilities.description: Applications that use UriComponentsBuilder to parse an externally provided URL and perform validation checks on the host may be vulnerable to open redirect or SSRF.
